question: From what measure is the width of a pillar said to be determined?
premises: The width of a pillar is declared.
It is derived from the measure of the house width.
An alternative is indicated by or.
inference: Pillar width is determined from the house width or by an alternative measure.
uncertainties: The alternative measure is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: The width of a pillar is declared to be derived from the width of the house, or otherwise.
